_comment: Copy to <project>/.mcp.json, drop the leading underscore from each server you want to enable, and fill in any placeholders. Docs: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/examples

_memory.instructions: Persistent knowledge graph. Enable for projects where cross-session memory matters.

_filesystem.instructions: Read/write a specific directory. Scope tightly — do not point at $HOME.

_github._comment: GitHub's official MCP server (Go binary, run via Docker image ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server). Replaces the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-github npm package. Source: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server. The ${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN} interpolation reads from the launching shell's env — module 50-claude-code can wire that up from 'gh auth token' via the wsl-starter:claude-github-token rc-block (CLAUDE_GH_TOKEN_EXPORT=1).
